item.title: Court blocks White House ballroom construction
item.description: A federal appeals court blocked construction of President Trump's $400 million White House ballroom, citing congressional approval issues.

item.title: ICE policy says body camera video released only when in agency's 'best interests'
item.description: ICE plans to equip officers with body cameras within two months, but public access to footage will be limited.

item.title: Inside Lindsay Clancy's Home | Case by Case | '48 Hours' Podcast
item.description: Jurors hear from medical professionals who treated Lindsay Clancy before and after her children's deaths.

item.title: Thailand school gunman kills grandparents, 3 teachers before shooting himself: Police
item.description: At least seven killed and over a dozen injured in a school shooting on the outskirts of a Thai city.
